sentence: This project builds a screening algorithm from routine patient-clinician encounters to identify patients with mild cognitive impairment and early-stage dementia earlier.
This project studies what drives insulin resistance and how the sex of the cell donor changes it.
This project tries to build an AI-assisted ultrasound method to localize early pregnancy in resource-constrained settings.
This project focuses on the study of immunologic diseases and basic immunology.
This project tests whether blocking a protein that interacts with transcription factors is a safe and effective treatment for a leukemic disease.
This project sets up a core resource that produces and purifies viruses used to deliver and change genes in vision research.
This project studies how tissue resident memory T cells form in the joint, where they help cause arthritis flares.
This project builds imaging and electrophysiology tools to study neural circuits and cells involved in opioid drug seeking in animals.
This project studies how glycoforms of follicle stimulating hormone change gene expression in granulosa cells of young and older mice and women.
This project studies how harmful mutations in a gene linked to Alzheimer's disease change the structure and stability of its protein.
This project builds web resources that describe how proteins bind DNA and RNA to study gene regulation.
This project tries to find out how anesthetic medications interact with the lymphatic system and its handling of fluid.
This project tries to find out how a small molecule reactivates the paternal allele lost in Angelman syndrome and designs safer analogs.
This project studies what HIV-1 integrase does while virions form and tests allosteric integrase inhibitors that target this step.
This project builds targeted assays that measure proteins and their modifications in specific types of neurons, in relation to drugs of abuse.
This project studies why CRISPR-associated transposons insert DNA in the same orientation each time, using structural biology and bioinformatics.
This project analyzes existing datasets to find out how to treat chronic pain and reduce prescription opioid risks.
This project builds a wearable wireless device that uses LED light on the head to measure blood pressure in newborns without invasive procedures.
This project studies how mutations in untranslated regions of genes help tumors escape the immune system across tumor types.
This project builds a microfluidic platform with electrochemical aptamer-based sensors to record cell death and cytokine secretion from human tumor biopsies.
